claim.statement: The publisher's current Auto Approve guide states that users can let selected categories proceed without a prompt, including project or all-file edits and safe or approval-required terminal commands.

source.title: Cline Auto Approve and YOLO Mode guide

values: Auto Approve enabled for selected categories

limitations: This is a rolling publisher guide captured on 31 July 2026, not independently tested behavior.
The guide states that command classification is model-supplied rather than based on a fixed command allowlist.
unknowns: The effective settings for a particular installation and task are unknown.
The reliability of model-supplied command classification was not assessed.

relationships.note: The apparent conflict is resolved because this claim applies when selected Auto Approve categories are enabled and the other applies when Auto Approve is disabled.
